id.instruksi: Dengarkan percobaan di rumah. Pilih hal yang sengaja diubah, hal yang harus dibuat sama, atau hal yang diukur agar ujinya adil.
id.p-gula-ubah: Apakah gula lebih cepat larut di air hangat daripada di air dingin? Apa yang sengaja diubah?
id.p-gula-sama: Uji gula di air hangat dan dingin: apa yang harus dibuat sama di kedua gelas?
id.p-gula-ukur: Uji gula di air hangat dan dingin: apa yang diukur?
id.p-gula-sama2: Uji gula di air hangat dan dingin: selain banyak gula, apa lagi yang harus sama?
id.p-pesawat-ubah: Apakah pesawat kertas bersayap lebar terbang lebih jauh daripada yang bersayap sempit? Apa yang sengaja diubah?
id.p-pesawat-sama: Uji pesawat kertas bersayap lebar dan sempit: apa yang harus dibuat sama?
id.p-pesawat-ukur: Uji pesawat kertas bersayap lebar dan sempit: apa yang diukur?
id.p-pesawat-sama2: Uji pesawat kertas bersayap lebar dan sempit: selain jenis kertas, apa lagi yang harus sama?
id.p-kain-ubah: Kain mana yang paling banyak menyerap air tumpahan? Apa yang sengaja diubah?
id.p-kain-sama: Uji mencari kain yang paling banyak menyerap air: apa yang harus dibuat sama?
id.p-kain-ukur: Uji mencari kain yang paling banyak menyerap air: apa yang diukur?
id.p-gula-curang: Rina menguji gula di air hangat dan air dingin, tetapi gelas air hangat diberi gula lebih sedikit. Mengapa ujinya tidak adil?
id.p-pesawat-curang: Dua pesawat kertas diuji, tetapi yang bersayap lebar dilempar oleh kakak yang lebih kuat. Mengapa ujinya tidak adil?

en.instruksi: Listen to the experiment at home. Choose what is changed on purpose, what must be kept the same, or what is measured so the test is fair.
en.i-banyakgula: how much sugar is put in
en.i-banyakair: how much water is in the glass
en.i-waktularut: time until the sugar has dissolved
en.i-lebarsayap: width of the paper plane's wings
en.i-kuatlempar: how hard and where it is thrown from
en.i-banyakserap: how much water the cloth soaks up
en.i-duaubah: two things were changed at once
en.i-dihalaman: it was tested in the yard
en.p-gula-ubah: Does sugar dissolve faster in warm water than in cold water? What do we change on purpose?
en.p-gula-sama: In the warm-and-cold sugar test: what must be kept the same in both glasses?
en.p-gula-ukur: In the warm-and-cold sugar test: what do we measure?
en.p-gula-sama2: In the warm-and-cold sugar test: besides the amount of sugar, what else must be the same?
en.p-pesawat-ubah: Does a paper plane with wide wings fly farther than one with narrow wings? What do we change on purpose?
en.p-pesawat-sama: In the wide-wing and narrow-wing paper plane test: what must be kept the same?
en.p-pesawat-ukur: In the wide-wing and narrow-wing paper plane test: what do we measure?
en.p-pesawat-sama2: In the wide-wing and narrow-wing paper plane test: besides the type of paper, what else must be the same?
en.p-kain-ubah: Which cloth soaks up the most spilled water? What do we change on purpose?
en.p-kain-sama: In the test of which cloth soaks up the most water: what must be kept the same?
en.p-kain-ukur: In the test of which cloth soaks up the most water: what do we measure?
en.p-gula-curang: Rina tests sugar in warm and cold water, but the warm glass gets less sugar. Why is the test not fair?
en.p-pesawat-curang: Two paper planes are tested, but the wide-winged one is thrown by an older brother who is stronger. Why is the test not fair?
